note: SOUND-SIDE RECOMMENDATION consumed by the COMPOSER actor (games2/composer), which owns the authoritative binding + mix. Semantic event names to be reconciled with the game agents event interface. Sounds resolve via sounds/viewer_data.json. This expresses sound intent (which sound, bus, round-robin/jitter, reverb-zone + ducking hints); the composer decides the final mix and may override.  EVERY EVENT HERE IS TRIGGERED BY THE GAME (maintainer 2026-08-06: "The definition of an event is something that is triggered."). 22 recommendations for moments the game never reached — tools, containers, consumables, quests, coin/gem pickups, the legacy menu clicks — were removed rather than left listed as assignable. It is fine for a triggered event to have no sound; it is not fine to offer a moment that never happens.  MUSIC IS LEVEL WITH SFX (maintainer 2026-08-08: "turn up the volume on all the music in the game? The music is to low VS the sound effects"). The music bus was -20 against sfx -14 — a 6 dB deficit, half the amplitude — so it is now -14 too. This value OVERRIDES the engine's own default (context.ts DEFAULT_BUS_DB), so both were changed together; editing only one does nothing.

ducking.note: Side-chain: dip music by amount for release_ms when these play.

reverb_zones.note: Apply at runtime by region; keep one-shots dry. Preset per region tag.

playback_rules.one_shot: play once at event; apply category_gain_db + active reverb zone
playback_rules.round_robin: repeating sounds: cycle takes, never repeat last; apply per-sound variation (pitch/gain/timing jitter)
playback_rules.loop_crossfade: ambience: loop seamlessly; crossfade ~1.5s on region change; mix at ambience gain
playback_rules.duck: on ducking.triggers, dip music by ducking.music_duck_db for ducking.release_ms

events.note: no sound assigned — the Game Master assigns one in the wiki

consumes: sounds/<category>/<id>/metadata.json (per-asset contract incl. measured music + envelope + sync_points)
scale_match: For tonal sounds, read metadata.music (root_midi, max_shift_semitones); snap to the current music key and REPLACE pitch-jitter. Never shift atonal foley.
